social_circle.name: Lisa Buscetta

background.how_they_met: They met locally in Van Buren through overlapping church and family-community circles when they were young adults.
background.why_close: Lisa is Evan's main emotional anchor, household partner, calendar reality-checker, and the person he relies on most during anxious spells.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, complete sentences with practical reminders, gentle humor, and few emojis. She sends short check-ins, grocery notes, calendar corrections, and calming reality checks.

shared_activities: reviewing Evan's calendar before he says yes to commitments
recent_text_topics: Whether Evan should accept another arts council task or leave room in the week.
Grocery planning around pantry meals, ribs, produce, coffee, and tight budget weeks.
Reminders to walk, water the tomatoes, or step away from event stress when his anxiety starts climbing.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Evan is married and that his wife is 'the most important person in my daily life.' Q11 says she helps keep their calendar sane and is better at saying no when they are overcommitted. Q34 says they review the calendar before he agrees to commitments. Q43 and Q44 show that talking with his wife helps him calm down and that she helps him deal with conflicts factually.

social_circle.name: Mary Grant
social_circle.relationship: close art friend and arts mentor-peer

demographics.occupation: retired elementary art teacher and local watercolor painter

background.how_they_met: They met through Van Buren arts circles and the local arts council. Mary invited Evan into the volunteer watercolor workshop that became a turning point for him.
background.why_close: Mary took Evan seriously as an artist and organizer before he fully took himself seriously, and they continue to share arts council planning, watercolor practice, and local community values.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses friendly, thoughtful texts with full sentences, occasional photos of paintings, and practical event questions. She may send a thumbs-up or flower emoji, but mostly writes like a teacher giving calm guidance.

shared_activities: discussing booth space and display rules
recent_text_topics: Planning sign-up sheets, supply needs, and room setup for a watercolor workshop.
Which local artists should be invited so the display feels more welcoming and representative.
Checking on Evan after a volunteer disagreement and helping him keep the issue from becoming personal.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 explicitly names Mary Grant as the local painter who asked Evan to help coordinate a volunteer watercolor workshop. Q07 says 'Mary Grant is a good art friend.' Q02 also says the workshop changed how Evan saw himself and led him to more arts council meetings and public speaking.

social_circle.name: Tommy Ray Whitaker

background.how_they_met: They met through the Ozark Trail Hiking Club after Evan began hiking regularly on Saturdays.
background.why_close: They bonded through repeated Saturday hikes, shared middle-aged aches, trail routines, and a low-pressure friendship that does not require Evan to explain himself too much.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and casually, often with weather screenshots, trail times, jokes about knees, and short replies like 'Sounds good' or 'Bring poles.' Rarely uses emojis except a thumbs-up.

shared_activities: Saturday hikes with the Ozark Trail Hiking Club
sharing knee, boot, and snack preferences
social_circle.communication_frequency: weekly, more often before Saturday hikes
recent_text_topics: Whether a trail is too steep for Evan's knee soreness and whether to bring hiking poles.
Saturday meetup times, weather, snacks, and who is driving.
Light Razorbacks comments and joking about not being twenty-five anymore.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Evan has 'a few men from the Ozark Trail Hiking Club' he sees most Saturdays and that they know each other's 'knees, boots, and snack preferences.' Q15 says Saturdays often include hiking with the club. Q33 says Evan uses poles when needed because of knee soreness.

social_circle.name: Angela Buscetta Martin

background.how_they_met: Angela is Evan's older sister. They grew up together in and around Van Buren in a close Italian-American Southern Catholic family.
background.why_close: They share family history, Catholic parish ties, practical caregiving habits, and regular contact around parents, holidays, meals, and family logistics.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in a warm but busy style, mixing full sentences with quick fragments. She sends reminders, family updates, prayer requests, and occasional photos from meals or school events.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating rides, meals, and appointment help for aging parents or older relatives.
Planning the next Sunday dinner, including who is bringing sauce, cornbread, or dessert.
Family reactions to Evan's anxiety and how to talk about mental health without turning it into an argument.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Evan has siblings and cousins he stays in touch with 'mostly by phone, Sunday visits, and family meals.' Q35 says he helps older relatives with rides, meals, and checking in. Q01 describes his family culture around Italian-American Sunday dinners, church, music, and cousins.

social_circle.name: Nate Buscetta

demographics.occupation: community college student and part-time hardware store clerk

background.how_they_met: Nate is Evan's nephew through Evan's extended family. Evan has known him since birth and became a steady uncle figure because he and his wife do not have children of their own.
background.why_close: Nate sees Evan as a calm, creative adult who shows up for family, helps with practical problems, and offers encouragement without being overbearing.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses short casual texts, abbreviations, memes, and photos. He is more likely to send 'u home?' or a picture of something broken than a long paragraph.

shared_activities: talking about art, tools, and local events
recent_text_topics: Asking Evan for advice on fixing a shelf, choosing basic tools, or handling a small car issue.
Checking whether Evan and Lisa will be at the next family meal or cookout.
Sending jokes or comments during Razorbacks games and teasing Evan about his careful budgeting.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Evan and his wife do not have children but have 'nieces, nephews, and younger folks from church and the arts council' they care about. Q06 says extended family ties are maintained through phone, Sunday visits, and family meals. Q106 says Evan learned practical repair skills from his father, making him a plausible uncle people contact for hands-on help.
